headline: Lebanon obtains World Bank funding to boost delivery of digital public services | Biometric Update
summary: The Lebanese government has secured $150 million from the World Bank to implement the Lebanon Digital Acceleration Project. The project aims to boost delivery of digital public services.
why: World Bank lending supports public-sector reform and infrastructure in developing economies, and it signals donor confidence in Lebanon's reform programme.
